summary:
Iter58 — Checkout < $0.50 friendly-error fix and Stripe InvalidRequestError split — fully verified end-to-end. Backend 6/6 PASS via /app/backend/tests/test_iter58_checkout_min_total.py: (1) $0.10 product × 1 → HTTP 400 with detail starting 'Order total must be at least $0.50 — please add another item or pick a listing with a higher price.' (NOT 500); (2) $0.10 × 10 = $1.00 → HTTP 200 with checkout.stripe.com URL (quantity-stack pushes above floor); (3) $7.99 product → HTTP 200 with valid Stripe URL — confirms automatic_tax fallback path silently retries when Stripe rejects with 'You must have a valid head office address' (the InvalidRequestError catch correctly detects 'tax'/'origin' substring and falls through to the no-tax retry); (4) empty cart → 400 'Cart is empty'; (5) policy_accepted=false → 400 'You must accept the Site Policies to checkout.'; (6) bogus discount_code → 400 starting 'Discount code rejected:'. Frontend live-verified on preview /cart with seeded cm_cart_v1 holding the $0.10 product (cart-total renders '$0.10'): after entering buyer@example.com, ticking cart-policy-checkbox, and clicking cart-checkout-btn, the red

below the button reads exactly 'Order total must be at least $0.50 — please add another item or pick a listing with a higher price.' (PASS — generic 'Checkout failed. Try again.' fallback is NOT shown). Zero pageerrors. Confirms CartPage.jsx setErr(e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Checkout failed. Try again.') correctly surfaces the backend's HTTPException(400, ...) detail string. axios interceptor (iter50) does not interfere — 400 detail is a string, not an array, so no flattening required.
critical_code_review_comments: [good] Pre-check at line ~319 (quote['total_before_tax'] < 0.50) catches the Stripe USD minimum BEFORE invoking Stripe — friendlier UX (no API round-trip) and protects against any future Stripe SDK changes that might surface the error inconsistently.

[good] InvalidRequestError catch on line 457 uses substring match on lowercased user_message OR str(e) for 'tax' or 'origin' — covers Stripe's two known phrasings ('automatic_tax requires…','origin address…'). Tax-config errors silently retry without automatic_tax, all other InvalidRequestErrors propagate as friendly 400 with Stripe's user_message — exactly the UX split the user asked for.
[good] Same InvalidRequestError catch on the no-tax retry (line 477) means a malformed line item or amount would still surface as a 400 instead of a 500 — defense in depth.

[good] Generic Exception catch on line 468 only fires DURING the with-tax attempt (legacy behavior preserved) and silently retries — keeps backwards compatibility with any Stripe-SDK exception class that isn't InvalidRequestError but still indicates tax-config trouble.
[good] Frontend e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Checkout failed. Try again.' is the right fallback chain — if backend returns a string detail it's shown verbatim, otherwise the generic stays.

[minor] Pre-check uses 0.50 as a magic number — could be promoted to a module-level STRIPE_USD_MIN = 0.50 const for clarity and easier currency expansion (Stripe's minimum varies per currency: GBP=0.30, EUR=0.50, etc.). Not blocking — current code is USD-only by line_items currency='usd'.

[minor] The substring check 'tax' in msg is broad enough to match unrelated future error messages containing the word (e.g. 'tax_id' validation issues that should NOT be silently retried). Consider switching to e.code or e.param checks if Stripe SDK exposes structured fields. Acceptable for now since automatic_tax is the only known tax-axis error path.
[minor·carry-over] Hydration warning '<span> in <option>' from CustomOrdersList still fires (iter54+ carry-over, NOT introduced by iter58).

success_rate.frontend: 100% — friendly error message surfaces verbatim on /cart, 0 pageerrors

seed_data_creation: Seeded cm_cart_v1 in localStorage with the existing $0.10 product 910b1738-03b4-4f8d-8422-a27a12e42f83 to reproduce the < $0.50 path — no DB writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter58 fully verified. The automatic_tax fallback IS active in the current preview — Stripe test mode rejects the first attempt with 'valid head office address' missing and the no-tax retry succeeds, returning a real cs_test_… URL. If you re-run, expect 'automatic_tax rejected by Stripe, retrying without it' WARN logs in backend.*.log — that is the happy path, not a regression. Sample products: $0.10 = 910b1738-03b4-4f8d-8422-a27a12e42f83; valid higher-priced = 88c9ae9d-6c48-4083-bb8e-fb2d8e1226c0. Cart localStorage key is 'cm_cart_v1' (not 'cm_cart').
rca_of_the_issue: BEFORE the fix, /api/checkout/session caught all Stripe errors as generic Exception → silent retry without automatic_tax → second call also failed (because $0.10 < Stripe USD minimum $0.50) → final outer try/except returned 500 → frontend showed 'Checkout failed. Try again.' with no actionable info. AFTER the fix: (a) total < $0.50 is pre-checked and returns 400 with a friendly message before Stripe is ever called; (b) stripe.error.InvalidRequestError is split into tax-only (silent retry) vs everything-else (HTTPException 400 with user_message surfaced). Reproduction: POST /api/checkout/session with items=[{product_id:'910b1738-03b4-4f8d-8422-a27a12e42f83',quantity:1}]. Mitigation verified end-to-end.
